subject: english
stem: This article explains that bees carry material from one flower to another, helping many plants form fruit. Why was it written?
options: to warn that every bee is dangerous
to tell where one bee slept
to explain how bees help plants
to ask readers to buy fruit

optionRationales.reason: to warn that every bee is dangerous：與 help plants 主旨不合。
to tell where one bee slept：不是個別故事。
to explain how bees help plants：內容說明過程與作用。
to ask readers to buy fruit：沒有購買呼籲。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「文體、內容安排與讀者預期行動共同指向的寫作目的」可推出 to explain how bees help plants；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 to explain how bees help plants 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
